story.headline: Built on trust, driven by passion
story.body: FTJ Exports has spent over a decade sourcing rare and remarkable vehicles for collectors and enthusiasts across the globe. Every car we list is inspected, verified and ready for its next chapter.

about.intro: FTJ Exports connects collectors and enthusiasts worldwide with exceptional vehicles — sourced, inspected and shipped with uncompromising care.

values.headline: Trust, built one car at a time
values.body: Every vehicle in our showroom is personally inspected and verified before it reaches you. We believe a good deal is built on honesty, not pressure — no hidden fees, no surprises, just the right car and a straightforward process from inquiry to delivery.

passion.headline: Built for speed, driven by passion
passion.body: Our team lives and breathes performance cars. That passion shows in how we source, describe and present every vehicle — with the detail and respect each one deserves.

shipping.headline: Shipping, handled end to end
shipping.body: From first inquiry to the moment your car arrives, we manage every step — paperwork, logistics and customs — so you don't have to.
